d:
Panjab ka ek ganv apne anokhe nam 'iraq' ki vajah se charcha men hai. ludhiyana zile men sthit yah ganv apne is khas nam ke karan aksar logon ka dhyan khinchta hai. yahan ki ek sthaniy lok-katha, jo pirhiyon se chali aa rahi hai, is bat ko batati hai ki is ganv ka nam 'iraq' kaise para.
Riport gurmindar sinh greval
Editing sukhmandip sinh
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
